Class RandomAccessFileMethods

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.intrinsic.RandomAccessFileMethods
public final class RandomAccessFileMethods extends Object
The read-only java.io.RandomAccessFile subset, backed by the SD card's open-file table: a file opened with mode "r" by a compile-time literal path, then seek/getFilePointer/length, single-byte and buffer reads, skipBytes and close. Failures raise the JDK's own exceptions, so the same code runs on a desktop JVM against a local file.
